name: GUI
tooltip:
GUI related settings.
§bMiddle click §f- Bind any module (including this for GUI bind)
§bScroll wheel §f- Scroll categories/modules if they are too long
§bFeatures §f- Restrict what type of modules to show

values.name: Reset GUI color

name: AntiCheat
tooltip:
Detects suspicious behaviour of players around you. May not be 100% accurate.
§d/anticheat §f- Set anticheat message colors

name: AntiObfuscate
tooltip: Deobfuscates text.

name: ArmorAlerts
tooltip: Alerts you when players buy an armor upgrade.

name: AutoChannel
tooltip: Automatically switches chat channel when joining/leaving a party.

name: AutoSafelist
tooltip: Automatically safelists players that take a final death.

name: AutoTip
tooltip: Automatically runs /tipall every x minutes.

name: AutoWho
tooltip: Automatically runs /who after a game started. May be required by some modules.

name: BreakProgress
tooltip: Displays a countdown until block is broken.

name: Cape
tooltip:
Renders a cape on players. You may import your own cape file.
§d/capefolder §f- Open cape folder
§bText §f- Input the custom cape file name

name: ConsumeTimer
tooltip: Displays a countdown of how much time left to consume an item.

name: Denicker
tooltip: Tells you the name of a nicked player if they are using their real skin.

name: HealthDisplay
tooltip: Displays various health information.

name: ItemAlerts
tooltip: Alerts in chat when a player holds a specific item.

name: ItemHighlight
tooltip:
Highlights important items in your inventory.
§d/itemsl §d<item> §f- safelist
§d/itemusl §d<item> §f- unsafelist
§d/itembl §d<item> §f- blacklist
§d/itemubl §d<item> §f- unblacklist

name: LatencyAlerts
tooltip:
Warns you in chat when you lose connection to the server. 
 May not work on all servers.

name: Notifications
tooltip:
Select which notifications to send in chat.
§bPrefer §f- Select whether to prefer notifications, chat messages, or both.

name: NoTitles
tooltip: Disables titles

name: NullMove
tooltip: Does not prevent movement if several movement keys are held at once.

name: ConsumeAlerts
tooltip: Alerts you when players consume a specific item.

name: ResourceTracker
tooltip: Tracks resources in your inventory.

name: ShinyPots
tooltip: Renders potion color as slot background.

name: Sprint
tooltip: Automatically toggles sprint for you.

name: Stats
tooltip: Displays certain stats of players.

name: StrengthESP
tooltip: Renders a box on players who have the Strength effect.

name: UpgradeAlerts
tooltip: Alerts when a team buys a team upgrade.

name: ViewClip
tooltip: Allows your view to clip through blocks when in third person.

name: SkywarsAlerts
tooltip: Alerts you of items players have in Skywars.

name: MiningAlerts
tooltip: Alerts you when a player mines Diamond Ore.

name: CooldownHUD
tooltip: Display item cooldowns on screen.

name: AutoText
tooltip: Automatically send a message on key press.

name: AutoChest
tooltip:
Automatically deposit resources into a chest. Only works in bedwars.
§cWARNING: §cLow §cdelays §care §cdetectable!

name: NoArmorDye
tooltip: Removes dye from leather armor.

name: EquipAlerts
tooltip: Alerts when a player equips selected armor piece.

name: ChestESP
tooltip: Highlights chests

values.name: Reset opened

name: Settings
tooltip:
General Meowtils settings.
§bAuto-Updates §f- Automatically download new updates
§bSmooth font §f- Toggle smooth font for HUD elements
§bCopy chat §f- Copy hovered chat message on right click
§bPrefix §f- Change chat prefix colors
§d/theme §f- Set custom prefix colors

name: PotionHUD
tooltip: Display important potion effects on screen.

name: HotbarLock
tooltip: Lock slots in your hotbar.

name: PearlDetector
tooltip:
Detects thrown pearls & displays various information such as warp location
for other players and warp timer for yourself.

name: AutoSwap
tooltip: Automatically swap slots when running out of certain items.

name: BlockCount
tooltip: Displays block count on screen.

name: BedTracker
tooltip: Alerts when enemy players are near your bed and shows distance to your bed on screen.

name: InstantHurt
tooltip: Instantly render hurt animation on players clientside.

name: DelayRemover
tooltip:
Remove or reduce certain delays.
§6NoBreakDelay §f- Remove or reduce delay between block breaks
§6NoUseDelay §f- Releases right click after required use duration
§6NoHitDelay §f- Removes delay if you miss an attack
§6NoJumpDelay §f- Removes delay between jumps
§cWARNING: §cSome §cof §cthese §cfeatures §cmay §cbe §cdetectable.

name: AutoStairs
tooltip: Automatically jumps when going up stairs, for faster movement.

name: Anti-Invis
tooltip: Renders invisible players semi-transparent instead.

name: TrapNotifier
tooltip: Reminds when you're missing a trap and notify when you trigger one.

name: ActionSounds
tooltip: Plays a sound when performing certain actions.

name: Teams
tooltip: Makes certain modules ignore teammates.

name: PartyNotifier
tooltip: Sends a notification to party chat from selected modules.

values.name: Reset messages

name: Icons
tooltip: Settings for player icons.

name: SniperWarning
tooltip: Warns you of certain players that may be snipers.

name: Animations
tooltip:
Allows you to change certain animations. Visual only.
§eNote: §eRightclick §eonly §eworks §eon §ewindows.

name: AntiMisplace
tooltip: Prevents placing obsidian if it isn't around a bed.

name: AutoGG
tooltip:
Automatically sends messages on game start/end.
§d/autogg|/autogl <add|remove|list> <msg> §f- Add/remove/list messages

name: Requeue
tooltip:
Allows you to manually or automatically requeue last played Hypixel game.
§d/rq §f- Requeue last played game

name: ItemESP
tooltip: Highlights important dropped items.

name: Indicators
tooltip: Highlights dangerous projectiles.

name: AccountHider
tooltip:
Visually modify account information.
§d/customname <name> §f- Set custom name

name: SessionStats
tooltip: Tracks your own stats for this game session.

values.name: Reset

name: EventTimers
tooltip: Displays event timers.

name: TimeChanger
tooltip: Changes time clientside.

name: BedESP
tooltip: Highlight beds and surrounding obsidian.

name: HeightOverlay
tooltip: Displays map height in HUD and colors wool.

name: ShopHelper
tooltip:
Helps you shop faster by highlighting affordable items, replacing clicks with middle clicks and
preventing purchasing certain duplicate items.

name: NoParticles
tooltip: Removes certain particles for visibility and performance.

name: UpgradeHUD
tooltip: Displays team upgrades on your screen. Only works with English language selected on Hypixel.

name: DamageTags
tooltip: Displays damage dealt after hitting someone.

name: ItemScale
tooltip: Scale dropped items.

name: MurdererFinder
tooltip: Highlights the murderer and alerts for other relevant roles in Murder Mystery.

name: Freelook
tooltip: Allows you to look around in third person without changing your serverside view.

name: HealthESP
tooltip: Renders a health bar on players.

name: PartyDetector
tooltip: Detects when a party joins your lobby.

name: NickBot
tooltip:
Automatically reroll nicks on Hypixel. Press ESC to stop it.
§d/nickbot §f- For more info about commands

name: PingHUD
tooltip: Displays your ping.

name: GhostHand
tooltip: Allows you to interact through entities.

name: ChatFilter
tooltip:
Removes filtered messages.
§d/meowfilter §f- Show commands

name: AutoBlacklist
tooltip:
Automatically adds players to the blacklist for selected events.
§cNOTE: Some features require AntiCheat module to be enabled.

name: PickupAlerts
tooltip: Alerts you when someone picks up a resource.
